description: MTConnect Sonder-Edge of cnc-mtc-01: reads the MTConnect agent and serves it as OPC-UA (bridge). Capacity = signal count today, measured 23.09. Runs today as an old v4 edge; its move to v5 (emitter.type unsac-edge, the target) is open (owner 30.10.2026).
$feedback: loaded only (no v4 process observes its subjects; seen stays undeclared until one does). maxAgeSeconds 900 = 3 x the 300 s tick of edge-kg-publisher, the slowest periodic model reader on an edge (CAPT-SOLLIST Befund 2); edge-runtime itself is push-fed and has no cadence of its own.
